name_note: GTDB's Prevotella copri_B is one clade of the organism the literature now calls Segatella copri, a complex that has been divided into several species.

sentences.text: The Segatella copri complex contains key members of the human gut microbiome, and a commentary notes that a study expanded it to 13 species with species-specific associations with lifestyle and health.
Segatella copri is described as a prevalent ancestral commensal that typically shows greater oxygen sensitivity than Bacteroides species.

A study reported that strains carrying the additional oxygen-response regulator OxyR are more prevalent in industrialized countries, and absent in people with traditional lifestyles and in ancient human samples.
Work on a microbiota-directed complementary food for undernourished Bangladeshi children identified Segatella copri strains with polysaccharide utilization loci targeting its glycans.
A Bangladeshi Segatella copri isolate carrying those loci metabolised the food glycans and promoted weight gain in a gnotobiotic mouse model.
